author: Parashyyy Thagunna
review_text: eSewa is great for sending and receiving money digitally, but without easy cash-in and cash-out, it’s basically a locked wallet you can’t open when you need cash. Most stores refuse to load or withdraw cash even if they display the eSewa logo. For people without bank accounts, this is a nightmare — money gets stuck inside the app with no way to convert it to physical cash. eSewa must fix this urgently and make cash withdrawals and deposit truly accessible for everyone.
